# Hayden Schultz

> Portfolio of Hayden Schultz, a CS student at WPI concentrating in cybersecurity and minoring in ECE. Work spans application security and systems engineering. Currently looking for a Summer 2027 internship.

Each project below links to a full write-up covering role, stack, technical depth, and (where applicable) limitations and media.

## Projects

- [Insurance Content Management System](https://haydenschultz.dev/projects/insurance-cms): Content platform for an insurance client, with natural-language database querying on top.
- [Music Audio Visualizer](https://haydenschultz.dev/projects/music-visualizer): Turns whatever's playing in your browser into a real-time, color-reactive 3D visualizer.
- [Proxmox Detection Engineering & Hobby Homelab](https://haydenschultz.dev/projects/proxmox-homelab): Built a hardened Proxmox lab, attacked it myself, and proved the SIEM saw it.
- [Subpixel](https://haydenschultz.dev/projects/subpixel): Encrypts a message and hides the ciphertext in the low bits of a PNG.
